premises.text: Rapid satellite growth makes Earth-space radio spectrum noisier and threatens consistency of communications that Earth services depend on
premises.evidence_span: As we go from 8,000 satellites to over 100,000 satellites in space, the issue that we're facing is that it's becoming much noisier. It's the spectrum noise and the consistency of communication that MagnaStar is addressing

premises.text: Current spectrum obtainment, coordination, and rights protection processes are outdated 25-year-old technology unfit for the modern space sector
premises.evidence_span: the current process that satellite operators are going through in order to obtain spectrum, coordinate spectrum, as well as protect their spectrum rights, are quite outdated and using technology that's 25 years old

premises.text: 247X simulates co-linear multi-satellite interference events between Earth and space and embeds that simulation into coordination infrastructure
premises.evidence_span: We simulate how multiple satellites, when they will be in a co-linear event and potentially interfere with one another from their signal communications in between Earth and space. We embed that simulation technology into coordination infrastructure

premises.text: The platform automates portions of the prove-no-interference coordination workflow that otherwise costs operators millions across many counterparties
premises.evidence_span: MagnaStar has understood this process, embedded it within the technology workflow that we have built to automate portions of that process, expediting how satellite operators coordinate, protecting their spectrum rights, and monitoring in near real-time

premises.text: Software continuously ingests ITU filings, auto-runs interference simulations against an operator's constellation, and flags new filings and modified coordination agreements
premises.evidence_span: I have all the new filings that have been released from the International Telecommunications Union over the last two weeks. The system has automatically run whether or not they will cause simulations or signal interference to my existing constellation

premises.text: Operators can run multiple uplink, downlink, or inter-satellite interference assessments for near-real-time passes or multi-year coordination thresholds in one application
premises.evidence_span: I can go ahead and run multiple simulations at a time, which is currently non-existent within the existing technology

premises.text: An operator-operator sandbox completes coordination and can send completed workflows directly to regulators
premises.evidence_span: we're requesting more information directly within this operator-operator sandbox and completing the coordination. If we decide to complete, we send directly to the regulator, and it signals off and completes the workflow

premises.text: The product is built as a spectrum exchange that only works once non-interference and coordination adherence are validated for subleasing
premises.evidence_span: we are building this to be a spectrum exchange. This spectrum exchange can only come to fruition as we have validated that it will not cause interference as we're subleasing spectrum and the coordination agreements are still being adhered to

premises.text: ITU community embedding aims to make the platform the new standard for satellite operators and regulators
premises.evidence_span: I am a Canadian delegate of the International Telecommunications Union under the United Nations. We are moving forward for this to be the new standard for all satellite operators and regulators
